description: Autonomously explores websites to collect planning trajectories, then uses hindsight to synthesize strictly aligned high-level planning training data for GUI/web agents.
training_prompt: Given only a target URL, autonomously explore the site to discover task primitives, then produce (a) a high-level plan for a novel OOD task on the same site and (b) a hindsight-refined training example pairing the plan with grounded GUI actions.
expected_improvement: Improves agentic_capability_score and transfer_learning_rate by generating aligned planning data that targets cross-website generalization.

description: Maintains a bi-temporal ledger for retrieved facts and deterministically retires superseded assertions to prevent stale-fact errors in evolving knowledge bases (e.g., code/config changes).
training_prompt: You are maintaining a project knowledge base over time. Given a chronological stream of (subject, relation, object) assertions with contradictions, return answers that are temporally valid at the query time, explicitly marking which prior facts were superseded and why.
expected_improvement: Improves metacognition_accuracy and zero_shot_success_count by reducing stale-memory failure modes during long-horizon agent tasks.

description: Decomposes holistic evaluation criteria into atomic binary questions to produce interpretable scores and question-level feedback that can drive iterative prompt/self-improvement loops.
training_prompt: For a given model output and rubric, generate 8-15 atomic yes/no evaluation questions, answer each with evidence, then propose one targeted revision to the prompt based on the failing questions and re-evaluate.
expected_improvement: Improves recursive_self_improvement_rate by providing structured, inspectable feedback signals for self-update cycles.

technique: Governed shared memory primitives for agent fleets
description: Defines primitives for scoped retrieval, temporal supersession, provenance tracking, and policy-governed propagation in multi-agent shared memory systems; introduces a harness for probing these properties.
training_prompt: Design a memory governance policy for a 5-agent team (roles, scopes, write permissions). Given a sequence of writes including contradictions, show what each agent can retrieve at each step, and provide provenance traces for any derived conclusions.
expected_improvement: Improves agentic_capability_score and metacognition_accuracy by training explicit governance/provenance reasoning in multi-agent contexts.

description: Jointly updates an experiential rule pool and the policy using the same interaction trajectories; retrieves task-relevant rules at decision time to condition action selection.
training_prompt: From an interaction trajectory, extract 3-7 generalized experiential rules (preconditions, action, expected outcome). Then solve a new task by retrieving and applying the most relevant rules, explaining which rule fired at each step.
expected_improvement: Improves skill_acquisition_rate and sample_efficiency_trend by consolidating reusable rules from limited trajectories.

description: Collapses large WebView accessibility trees to reduce node count substantially without losing tap targets, making hybrid apps more tractable for screen-based agents.
training_prompt: Given a raw accessibility tree and a collapsed version, demonstrate that all actionable elements are preserved by mapping tap targets and verifying task completion on three WebView-heavy screens.
expected_improvement: Improves multi_modal_integration_score and agentic_capability_score by enabling more efficient perception/planning over complex GUI structures.
